exposure: Patients grouped by treatment modality: obstetrical hysterectomy, uterine artery embolization (UAE), or bilateral internal iliac artery ligation (BIAL)
outcome: Changes in the management of intractable obstetrical hemorrhage
cohort: 122 cases of intractable obstetrical hemorrhage among 12,055 deliveries over a 15-year period (January 1997 to December 2011)
finding: The study observed a shift in the management of intractable obstetrical hemorrhage from hysterectomy towards uterine artery embolization, which was associated with significantly less morbidity and no mortality.
